repos_data.description: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
Package tasks is an easy to use in-process scheduler for recurring tasks in Go

MCP-powered task manager that lets Claude AI prioritize your work. Desktop app with Microsoft To Do-style UI, intelligent prioritization strategies (Eisenhower, quick wins, high impact), goal tracking, and concurrent SQLite access.
Local-first task manager with a visual weekly timeline. Works offline, syncs across devices, and self-hosts with one Docker command. Uses SQLite by default, so no external database is needed.
MCP server for TickTick task management via the v2 API. Field-preserving updates, day-of-week validation, completion tracking.
Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.

A task scheduler built with Go and Vue.js that allows users to specify recurring jobs via a simple YAML configuration file. The scheduler reads job definitions, executes commands at specified times using cron expressions, and passes in environment variables for each job.
An engine for managing the execution of container-based workflows.
Git powered terminal-based todo/note manager --  markdown note page per task. Single binary!
Create jobs on a time-based schedule on Docker Swarm

repo_meta_data.description: Donetick an open-source, user-friendly app for managing tasks and chores, featuring customizable options to help you and others stay organized
